requirement: Decide whether a caller role may create an account of the target role: Admin accounts can never be created through this flow, an Admin may create a medical regulation reviewer, head-of-department doctor, or doctor, a head-of-department doctor may create a doctor, and every other pairing is denied.

preconditions.text: The policy is a pure static function
The caller may create the target role
The caller may not create the target role

inputs.text: CanCreate ReturnsExpectedPermission (actor: Admin, target: Admin, expected: False)
CanCreate ReturnsExpectedPermission (actor: Admin, target: Doctor, expected: True)
CanCreate ReturnsExpectedPermission (actor: Admin, target: HeadDepartmentDoctor, expected: True)
CanCreate ReturnsExpectedPermission (actor: Admin, target: MedicalRegulationReviewer, expected: True)
CanCreate ReturnsExpectedPermission (actor: Doctor, target: Doctor, expected: False)
CanCreate ReturnsExpectedPermission (actor: HeadDepartmentDoctor, target: Doctor, expected: True)
CanCreate ReturnsExpectedPermission (actor: HeadDepartmentDoctor, target: HeadDepartmentDoctor, expected: False)
CanCreate ReturnsExpectedPermission (actor: HeadDepartmentDoctor, target: MedicalRegulationReviewer, expected: False)
CanCreate ReturnsExpectedPermission (actor: MedicalRegulationReviewer, target: Doctor, expected: False)

returns.text: True when the caller is allowed
An Admin may create reviewer, head-of-department doctor, or doctor accounts
A head-of-department doctor may only create doctors
False when the target is Admin
False for every other role pairing

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the policy always returns a bool
